body:
Hello, and welcome to your new mailbox.

Every now and then, when you least expect it, a letter will arrive. The flag goes up when there is mail. Some letters are notes, some are movies or books worth your evening, some are songs.

You can write back too. Your replies stay right here on your Mac.

It is also a good hiding spot. Drop files in, close the door, and your desktop is clear.

from: A friend who likes slow films
title: Paterson (2016)
body:
Watch this one on a quiet night.

It is a week in the life of a bus driver who writes poems in a notebook. Nothing big happens, and that is the whole point. You will notice small things for days after.

from: Someone who still believes in forest spirits
title: My Neighbor Totoro (1988)
body:
If you have had a long week, this is the cure.

Two sisters, a new house in the countryside, a bus shaped like a cat, and a big soft creature who waits in the rain. It is gentle from start to finish.

from: A reader on the night train
title: The Little Prince
body:
You can read it in one sitting, but it stays with you for years.

A pilot lands in the desert and meets a small boy from a very small planet. It looks like a children's book. It is not only a children's book.
signoff: Read it again if you already have.

from: Your neighbour with the record player
title: Here Comes the Sun
body:
Put this on the next time it has been grey for too long.

Two minutes in, you will be humming. Three minutes in, you will be looking out the window.

from: Ralph Waldo Emerson, by way of a friend
body:
"Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience."

I wrote this on a card and kept it on my desk for a year. Passing it on to you.

from: Someone who noticed you have been busy
body:
This is your reminder to stand up.

Go outside for ten minutes. No phone if you can manage it. Look at one tree properly. Come back.

The work will still be here.

Quick question, no need to answer.

Who was the last person you wrote a real letter to? Maybe today is a good day to write another one. You can practice on me. Press Write back.
